name: padlock_locked
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: locked padlock UI icon for a hand-drawn 2D forest mushroom game. It is used at 56 and 96 pixels, so clarity is essential.
Input images: image 1 is the existing padlock edit target. Image 2 is the recently refined closed cocoon, a style reference for bold ink and matte subdued shading only.
Primary request: give the padlock a polished art pass consistent with image 2. Keep a single CLOSED upright front-facing padlock: thick rounded arch shackle, slightly tapered rounded rectangular body and a large simple centered black keyhole with round top and flared triangular stem. Preserve the original silhouette and proportions, readable without decoration. Use a warm muted gray-ivory shackle and a desaturated olive-gray body. Add only broad matte cel-shaded facets: a restrained pale upper-left bevel and a darker olive lower-right side. Give the shackle a subtle dark inner edge for thickness. Keep the interior of the arch completely transparent so backgrounds show through. Opaque body with an opaque near-black keyhole.
Style: heavy almost-black softly hand-inked contours, friendly organic corners, simple substantial forms, broad subdued cel shading, the same quiet earthy palette as the reference. No glossy shine, bright white streaks, gleaming metal, texture noise, gold, decorative engravings, rivets, leaves or mushrooms.
Composition: one padlock centered on a square transparent canvas, complete uncropped outline, roughly 3:4 width-to-height silhouette, ample empty margins like the original. No rotation or perspective tilt.
Constraints: genuine transparent alpha background, no painted checkerboard, no ground shadow, backdrop, text, watermark, key, open shackle or extra objects. Output one locked padlock only.
